svg.text: COVERAGE · TITLE IV MANDATE VS VOLUNTARY PDF
A school with no public CDS still has a Scorecard row

text.tspan: College Scorecard covers Title IV institutions because IPEDS
reporting is mandatory. The Common Data Set is a voluntary
guidebook template. That is why the directory stub exists:
federal baseline facts without pretending a CDS was published.

svg.text: Harvey Mudd and Virginia Tech both publish a CDS. The coverage gap is everyone else.
